title: Beta-alanine: why does it make you TINGLE? ⚡
caption:
It raises carnosine, which soaks up acid in hard 1-4 minute efforts. Little help for one heavy set. The tingle is harmless. Have you felt it? 👇

General information, not medical advice.

Supplement Series, Part 7
first_comment: Love it or hate it: the beta-alanine tingle ⚡
sources: Trexler ET et al. International Society of Sports Nutrition position stand: beta-alanine. J Int Soc Sports Nutr 2015;12:30 (4-6 g/day for 2-4+ weeks; 1-4 min efforts; paresthesia harmless, reduced by split doses)
